short.q: Give two reasons for using subroutines in a program.
short.model: Subroutines split a large program into smaller parts that are easier to write and test, and the same code can be reused many times without being rewritten.

short.q: Write a function Double that takes an integer and returns twice its value.
short.model:
FUNCTION Double(N : INTEGER) RETURNS INTEGER
  RETURN N * 2
ENDFUNCTION
points: Function header with parameter and RETURNS

short.q: Write pseudocode to input a word and output it in upper case followed by its length.
short.model:
INPUT Word
OUTPUT UCASE(Word)
OUTPUT LENGTH(Word)

short.q: A 1D array Prices[1:50] holds prices. Write pseudocode to output the total of all prices.
short.model:
Total ← 0
FOR I ← 1 TO 50
  Total ← Total + Prices[I]
NEXT I
OUTPUT Total

short.q: Explain why the programmer should use meaningful variable names and comments.
short.model: Meaningful names and comments make the code easier to understand, so it is easier for another programmer to debug and maintain or update later.
